description: Grants a second physical strike every turn dealing 50% of base ATK damage. The bonus strike cannot crit and is not affected by skills.
The first hit dealt in each turn is empowered, dealing 150% of normal damage. Considered the 'Bankai burst' — subsequent hits in the same turn deal normal damage.
Heals the wielder for 15% of the physical damage dealt by each hit. Lifesteal cannot overheal beyond max HP.
All attacks deal an additional 20% bonus fire-element damage. Fire damage is not reduced by DEF but may be resisted by fire-immune enemies.
On landing a critical hit, reflects 50% of the enemy's last dealt damage back at them as true damage. Triggers once per crit, not per multi-hit.
All attacks bypass the enemy's DEF stat entirely, always dealing true damage. Does not stack with other true-damage effects — the bypass itself IS the effect.
Each attack has a 20% chance to summon a shadow soldier that makes one additional strike for 40% of the player's ATK as true damage. Max one shadow soldier proc per player action.
Every 3 turns, the weapon releases a ground-splitting shockwave dealing 30% of the enemy's current HP as true damage to the enemy. Shockwave cannot kill — it reduces HP to 1 minimum.
At combat start, applies a hypnosis debuff that reduces enemy ATK by 25% for 3 turns. If the enemy is immune to status effects, the ATK reduction does not apply.

Each attack drains 10 MP from the enemy. Drained MP is added to the player's current MP pool (cannot exceed max MP). Enemies with 0 MP take bonus damage equal to the drain amount that would have occurred.
Player ATK grows by 5% at the end of each player turn, stacking up to 5 times (max +25% ATK). Stacks reset when the fight ends.
At the start of each enemy attack resolution, there is a 20% chance to completely nullify the incoming hit (dealing 0 damage). The roll happens per-attack in multi-hit enemy patterns.
When the player chooses the Defend action, there is a 35% chance to nullify the enemy's counter-attack entirely. The base defend damage reduction still applies on non-nullified hits.
At the end of each turn, reduces the enemy's max HP by 5% (rounded down). The reduction is permanent for the duration of the fight. The enemy's current HP is also reduced if it exceeds the new max.
When the player takes a single hit that exceeds 30% of their max HP, 100% of that hit's damage is reflected back at the enemy as true damage. Only triggers once per hit, not per turn.
For every 10% of max HP the player is missing, incoming damage is reduced by 5% (e.g. at 50% HP missing = -25% incoming damage). Bonus caps at 50% damage reduction (reached at 100% HP missing).
Every incoming attack — melee, ranged, or magic — has a 15% chance to be completely dodged (0 damage taken). The dodge roll is per-hit. Does not apply to true-damage or percentage-based HP effects.

At the start of each player turn (before the player's action), the Gate fires 1-3 random Noble Phantasm projectiles at the enemy. Each projectile deals 10% of the player's ATK as true damage. The count is chosen randomly each turn.

Reduces all incoming damage to 25 percent of its original value, after every other guard and mitigation has resolved. Applies everywhere damage lands: normal attacks, skills, boss nukes, dungeons and PvP. Never wears out.
Increases all outgoing damage you deal by 15 percent of your actual attack damage, applied on top of skill multipliers and crits.
Caps any single incoming hit at 35 percent of your max HP, which neutralises one tap finishers such as Cinder Verdict and Wishing Star. Never wears out.
Increases all outgoing damage you deal by 30 percent, applied on top of skill multipliers and crits.
The first turn that ends with you below 30 percent HP, you catch your breath and heal 25 percent of your max HP. Once per fight.
Every incoming hit has a 20 percent chance to tangle the attacker, cutting its ATK by 20 percent for 2 turns.
The leather learns from every blow: incoming damage drops 3 percent per hit you have already taken this fight, up to 30 percent. The first hit lands in full.
10 percent of every hit that lands on you is soaked out of the damage and into your MP pool instead, up to your max MP.
At the end of every turn the greenweave gives back 3 percent of your max HP. No condition, no limit on how often.
If nothing damaged you during the previous turn, your hit this turn lands 25 percent harder. A turn where every blow was dodged or nullified counts as clean.
Every Defend settles your footing for the rest of the fight: incoming damage drops another 8 percent per Defend taken, up to 40 percent.
The first incoming hit of every fight goes into the glass and deals nothing at all. Guaranteed, and only once per fight.
While the enemy has more HP left than you do, every hit you land deals 12 percent more. Checked fresh on each swing.
As the fight opens, the wick flares and burns the enemy for 5 percent of its max HP.
